title: 第二十一章 跟踪者第二十二章 不给面子
content_zh:
大黑林出产一些药材兽皮之类的土货，所以小小的赵家庄内也有着一条坊市街，里面的产业基本属于县城三大世家，叶枫此行的目的，就是那家叫做“百草庐”
的药铺。
他一路前行进入坊市街。
让叶枫没有察觉到的是，刚踏足此地，暗处就有一道阴冷目光如毒蛇一般盯上了他。
“百草庐”
的店面不大，店内并没有什么顾客，仅有的一个伙计趴在桌子上打盹。
叶枫信步而入，咳嗽了一声。
“这位客人……欢迎光顾，请问有什么需要？”
声音惊动了打盹的伙计，他连忙起身招呼，而一直在柜台边闭目养神的掌柜也抬头望向叶枫。
“叶枫？叶公子，是你？”
掌柜居然就是那位山羊胡子老头张掌柜，显然他对叶枫印象深刻，一下就认了出来。
“张掌柜，你好，在下有些灵药想要出售。”
叶枫笑着点了点头。
“好，好好，叶公子，昨天那些药材真的是你独自采到的？才在大黑林里待了三天就采到那么多灵药？”
老头子满脸堆笑，眼中露出好奇与惊诧。
“运气好，误打误撞闯进了一个药谷，所以才有昨天那些收获。
这里还有些带毒的，掌柜你看看，大概值什么价？”
叶枫很随意的笑了笑，随手将拎着的包裹递了上去。
“五毒幽兰？咦，还有黑斑狼草，这可是黄阶中品灵草，居然有四株之多？”
越看张掌柜心头越是吃惊。

每一种灵草灵果的习性都不相同，有些喜阴、有些喜阳，如果真如面前少年所说那般运气好，恰巧找到了一处适合灵药生长的药谷，那也只能采摘到同一种喜好的药材，无非就是量大一些罢了。
这么多习性各异的药材，显然不可能出自同一地方。
不过既然人家不愿意明说，张掌柜自然不会强人所难，一株株将药材取出来摆放在柜台上，等清点停当，这才噼里啪啦打起了算盘。
“四株黑斑狼草，市价三十两纹银一株，十三株五毒幽兰，十两纹银一株，还有六枚毒龙果，十五两一枚，一共是三百四十两，叶公子，给你三百五十两如何？”
叶枫笑道：“掌柜真是个爽快人，今后我采到药材，就卖给你们百草庐了。”
完成这一笔交易，百草庐赚头不小，张掌柜满脸喜气，看了叶枫一眼后开口道：“叶公子，除了收购之外，本店也贩卖一些低阶的丹药，不知道你有没有这方面的需求？”
“哦？都有什么？”
叶枫好奇问。
“炼体丹，聚气丹，另外我们这里还有增速丹和巨力丸。”
炼体丹是武士境四重以前的常用丹药，进入第五重化气境之后，就需要服用聚气丹了，至于增速丹、巨力丸等等，可以在服用之后一段时间内提升某方面的能力，对修为却不起作用。
至于赵家庄需要熬炼的“凝气散”
，则完全只是为了破开换血到化气阶段的瓶颈所用，对平时修炼没太大的效果，而且“凝气散”
content_en:
Daheilin produces some local goods such as medicinal materials and animal skins, so there is also a market street in the small Zhaojiazhuang. The industries in it basically belong to the three major aristocratic families in the county. The purpose of Ye Feng's trip is the one called "Baicao Lu"
's drug store.
He walked all the way into Fangshi Street.
What Ye Feng didn't realize was that as soon as he set foot here, a cold gaze stared at him from the dark like a poisonous snake.
"Baicao Cottage"
The store is not big, and there are not many customers in the store. There is only one waiter lying on the table and taking a nap.
Ye Feng strolled in and coughed.
"This guest... is welcome. What do you need?"
The sound alarmed the napping waiter, who quickly stood up to greet him. The shopkeeper, who had been resting at the counter with his eyes closed, also looked up at Ye Feng.
"Ye Feng? Mr. Ye, is it you?"
The shopkeeper turned out to be shopkeeper Zhang, an old man with a goatee. Apparently he was deeply impressed by Ye Feng and recognized him immediately.
"Hello, shopkeeper Zhang, I have some elixirs that I want to sell."
Ye Feng smiled and nodded.
"Okay, okay, Mr. Ye, did you really collect those medicinal materials yesterday alone? You only stayed in the Great Black Forest for three days and you collected so many elixirs?"
The old man was smiling with curiosity and surprise in his eyes.
"I was lucky. I accidentally broke into a medicine valley, so I got those harvests yesterday.
There are some poisonous ones here. Take a look, shopkeeper, what is their approximate price? "
Ye Feng smiled casually and handed the package he was carrying.
"Five Poison Orchid? Hey, there's also Black-spotted Wolfgrass. This is a middle-grade yellow-level spiritual grass. There are actually four of them?"
The more he looked at Shopkeeper Zhang, the more surprised he became.
Each type of spiritual grass and spiritual fruit has different habits. Some prefer yin and some prefer yang. If you are lucky as the young man in front of you said and happened to find a medicinal valley suitable for the growth of elixirs, you can only pick the same kind of medicinal materials you like, just in larger quantities.
So many medicinal materials with different habits obviously cannot come from the same place.
However, since they were unwilling to say it clearly, shopkeeper Zhang would not force anyone to do anything. He took out the medicinal materials one by one and placed them on the counter. After counting them, he started to make plans.
"Four black-spotted wolfgrass, with a market price of thirty taels of silver each, thirteen five-poison orchids, one twelve taels of silver, and six poisonous dragon fruits, fifteen taels each, a total of three hundred and forty taels. Mr. Ye, how about giving you three hundred and fifty taels?"
Ye Feng smiled and said: "The shopkeeper is really a cheerful person. From now on, when I collect the medicinal materials, I will sell them to you Baicaolu."
After completing this transaction, Baicaolu made a lot of profit. Shopkeeper Zhang was full of joy. He glanced at Ye Feng and said, "Mr. Ye, in addition to acquisitions, our store also sells some low-level elixirs. I wonder if you have any needs in this regard?"
"Oh? What's there?"
Ye Feng asked curiously.
"Body Refining Pill, Qi Gathering Pill, and we also have Speed Boosting Pill and Juli Pill here."
Body refining pills are commonly used elixirs before the fourth level of the warrior realm. After entering the fifth level of Qi transformation realm, you need to take Qi gathering pills. As for speed increasing pills, Juli pills, etc., they can improve certain abilities for a period of time after taking them, but they have no effect on cultivation.
